findings.body: `SelectionFilter` and the shared selection schema permit every operator with either a string or an array, but the existing answer query applies arrays only for `op: "in"`; array-valued `eq`/`neq` filters are ignored. This new predicate instead turns array `eq` into `IN` and array `neq` into `NOT IN`. A signed answer using such a valid selection can therefore show a row that the drill excludes, producing an empty footer and a 409 mismatch instead of the row's transactions. Either reject unsupported operator/value combinations before executing the answer or share the answer query's exact filter semantics here.
findings.title: Not done: Re-derive the executed GL filter predicate

findings.body: This test asserts only `outcome === "refused"` for other-user, lost-plant, lost-Actual, lost-domain, and expired cases. It never checks the required access and expiry messages or their HTTP statuses, so changing either mandated user-facing reason to a generic refusal would leave the suite green. Add controller-boundary assertions for the exact expired and access wording.
findings.title: Not done: exact expired and changed-access refusal wording tests

findings.body: The new `rowLabels` and `drill` properties are documented only as anonymous objects, so generated clients cannot discover `key`, `label`, `otherLabels`, `context`, `rows`, or `drillable`. The changed Swagger test merely checks that the property names exist and therefore passes with these hollow schemas. Define typed DTOs for both structures and assert their generated component shapes.
findings.title: Not done: typed Ask metadata Swagger contract test

findings.body: Runtime validation rejects non-integer pages, but the OpenAPI DTO declares an unconstrained numeric type, and the Swagger test explicitly locks in `type: "number"`. Generated clients may consequently treat values such as 1.5 as valid even though the endpoint returns 400. Declare and test the property as an OpenAPI integer.
findings.title: Document the page field as an integer

findings.body: This branch exports the signing seam and registers the read route, but no Ask response issues a context and no Actual cell invokes the route, so the user-facing click described by Done-when 3 is not reachable yet. The planned GL-ANSWER-WIRING task must issue `AskResponse.drill`, and GL-DRILL-PANEL must call this endpoint from the Actual cell.
findings.title: Later: make the route reachable from Ask answers → GL-ANSWER-WIRING and GL-DRILL-PANEL
